_comment: DV-145 asks nothing new in the packet, like DV-140 and DV-165. It is the judge's order on the DV-108 request - 'This is a Court Order.' on both pages - and it is attached to DV-140. The filer prepares items 1 and 2 and the proposed orders in items 4-10; every one of those is a question the packet already asks. Items 1 and 2 are the two names (DV-100) and their relationships to the children (DV-105), and items 4-10 are DV-108 items 4-10 box for box, so each field carries the name the asking form uses and one answer fills both. The judge's parts - item 3's findings, item 4's choice of area, items 11 and 12 and the case number - are courtUse in the field config. Nothing on DV-145 that the filer owns has a 'need more space' box, so nothing here continues on MC-025: the only continuation lines (3b(8) and 12) belong to the court. The groups, questions, combines and split below repeat DV-105's and DV-108's word for word, so the form compiled on its own reads the same and the packet collapses them into the questions already asked.
